coordinate_policy: Native geographic coordinates; no transformation or WGS84 relabeling. D_Sphere (radius 6371200 m) approved by the operator 2026-10-15. Read source_crs; D_Sphere output is not RFC 7946 WGS84.
subset_rule: Every forecast advisory and every available forecast geometry product. Plus each 5 km wind-speed-probability product, clipped to the boxes reaching one degree of latitude and longitude on each side of each public landmark.
